audience: Arabic-speaking office and factory staff (Egypt first) who use AI at work and the trainers of the AI Essentials course
promise: The 41-page AI Essentials book is now an interactive academy: units, four levels, animated scenes, real labs, ready prompts, quizzes — every count shown is the academy's real count
cta: ابدأ الرحلة (the academy's own button; no URL or contact supplied, none shown)
direction: One hero: a page of the book. It wakes on a click, its lines fly out into the six unit badges, the page becomes the app window, that one window morphs through levels, the equation, the lab, the prompt library (dark mode via the moon toggle), the quiz, then breaks into the 41 pages that implode into the logo on the drop. Look = the academy's redesign: white canvas, ink #111114, one blue #2f5fe6, signal colours, hairline borders, grey app window, circuit lines with dots, pill buttons; Inter + IBM Plex Sans Arabic (display/UI) and JetBrains Mono (formula, eyebrow). Springs by damping ratio, subframe motion blur, blur swaps, cursor narrator. No glow, confetti, particles or fade-and-slide-up on headlines.

creative.viewer: Egyptian office and factory staff who use AI at work, and the course trainers
